Commanders vs Giants DraftKings Showdown Picks: Thursday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Thursday Night Football, November 12 · NFL Week 10 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 11, 11:04 PM ET

Jayden Daniels has the highest SPAGS projection in the Commanders at Giants DraftKings Showdown: 18.5 points at $10,000 FLEX, 27.8 at captain for $15,000. In a game totaled at 40.5, the model's favorite play is the quarterback who also runs. It has him carrying 5.8 times, and across 100,000 simulations he holds 72% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Daniels is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 5.6 points at a $10,000 FLEX salary.

He also has the largest captain share: 22.3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Daniels at captain. Malik Nabers is the next captain in line, at 14.3%. The model gives him 7.9 targets on 27.8 routes.

The Giants are a 2.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 21.5 for the Giants and 19 for the Commanders.

Behind Daniels and Nabers, the next projections are J.J. McCarthy (15.9, $8,800), Cam Skattebo (12.5, $9,000) and Isaiah Likely (12.3, $8,200).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 11, 11:04 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 100,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

TNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Jayden Daniels, WAS QB ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Jayden Daniels holds 22.3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $15,000 and the 18.5-point SPAGS model projection becomes 27.8 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 5.8 rushing attempts. Across 100,000 simulations Daniels averaged 18.5 points with a simulated floor of 5.6 and a ceiling of 38.1. He holds 72% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 22.3% as the captain and 49.7% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Malik Nabers, NYG WR ($11,000 FLEX / $16,500 CPT)

Malik Nabers holds 14.3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $16,500 and the 15.1-point SPAGS model projection becomes 22.6 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 7.9 targets on 27.8 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Nabers averaged 15.1 points with a simulated floor of 2.7 and a ceiling of 39.9. He holds 45% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 14.3% as the captain and 30.6% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: J.J. McCarthy, NYG QB ($8,800 FLEX / $13,200 CPT)

J.J. McCarthy holds 12.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $13,200 and the 15.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 23.9 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. Across 100,000 simulations McCarthy averaged 15.9 points with a simulated floor of 5.0 and a ceiling of 31.7. He holds 65% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 12.4% as the captain and 52.7% in a FLEX spot.

Across 100,000 simulations Burks averaged 6.7 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 18.4. Commanders vs Giants DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Commanders vs Giants DraftKings Showdown?

Jayden Daniels holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 22.3%, ahead of Malik Nabers (14.3%) and J.J. McCarthy (12.4%), across 100,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Commanders vs Giants?

Build around Jayden Daniels at captain with J.J. McCarthy, Rachaad White and Stefon Diggs at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (119 of 100,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $9,400 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Commanders vs Giants DraftKings Showdown?

Jayden Daniels leads the SPAGS model at 18.5 DraftKings points for $10,000 at FLEX, or 27.8 points at captain for $15,000.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Commanders vs Giants Showdown?

Malik Nabers is the most expensive player at $11,000 FLEX and $16,500 at captain. All 31 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Commanders vs Giants DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Treylon Burks (6.7 points at $3,600), Austin Ekeler (7.5 points at $4,600) and Commanders (6.4 points at $4,400).

What is the Commanders vs Giants spread and total?

The Giants are a 2.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 40.5, with implied team totals of 21.5 for the Giants and 19 for the Commanders.
